sections.heading: What the comparison taught him
sections.content: Levesque had built TravelPod, a travel-blogging site, without knowing much about SEO or growth. When a site he thought had a poor product turned out to be 10 times bigger, he realized that product quality and strong engineering alone were not enough: they also needed to understand growth and its levers.

sections.heading: The growth lesson in practice
sections.content: In TravelPod’s market, “Travel Blog” was the top keyword, but TravelPod ranked second for a long time, and he could not recall whether it ever reached first. He came to look for the growth loop behind successful businesses and recognized that one strong channel—such as SEO, paid search, or virality—can drive a company forward. His lesson was to pair product-building with attention to the growth channel that can reach customers.
